# zPredict app

> Trading app for zPredict, a shielded prediction market on Zcash. A static site that talks to three relayers directly; no analytics, no third-party requests.

- [Markets](https://app.zpredict.site/): open markets with public prices
- [Relayer View](https://app.zpredict.site/trade/): what each relayer sees of an order (one random share)
- [Threat model](https://app.zpredict.site/threat-model/): what each party can and cannot learn
- [About](https://zpredict.site/): project overview, links to the source and design
